How It Works

Common Questions
I'm a job seeker — do I pay anything?

No. Placement support for candidates is free. Share your profile or apply to any opening and we'll guide you through the next steps.

How do I apply for a job?

Open any role on the job board and tap “Apply on WhatsApp”. Your message is pre-filled with the job title — just add your name and experience, and send. We'll confirm the current live vacancy for that role.

I'm an employer. How fast can I get profiles?

It depends on the role. Once we understand your requirement, we start sourcing right away and share a realistic timeline upfront — urgent shopfloor roles are usually faster than specialist ones.

Which locations do you cover?

Most of our current openings are in Faridabad, Gurugram, Manesar, Delhi NCR, Bhiwadi and Palwal. If your plant or office is elsewhere, contact us — we'll tell you honestly if we can help.

Can you help with bulk / multiple hiring?

Yes — for production, warehouse and field sales teams we regularly source multiple candidates against one requirement. Mention the number of openings in your enquiry.

How do I sign in or register on this website?

Use the Login section on this website. Register by entering your real details there — it opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send. Google Sign-In on the same page activates once the website's Google OAuth Client ID is connected for this domain; Google then handles your password, and this website never stores it. Enquiries sent on WhatsApp are end-to-end encrypted.
